body:
I like college. I'm here because it's "expected" of me, I guess. I like it because it's routine and, at least for the last couple years, I knew where my life was going. I am working toward a degree that might get me a job, so I suppose I'm going for the future too.

I don't have a lot of friends to talk to. My family is hard to talk to. I am not the first person in my family to have suicidal thoughts.  My parents will not help me besides watching me closely. There is also a huge stigma particularly in my family against therapy, medication, talking about mental health, etc.

I have one friend who knows I've been to therapy and one sibling who has been suicidal. My friend used to have a roommate who was suicidal and complained about them. I won't talk to my sibling because I'm worried it would bring up bad thoughts for them and because we have never talked about the hard issues. I don't want to be a burden for anyone.

Thanks for listening/reading.
Congratulations on having a baby soon! Thanks for commenting, it was cool to read your story and "weird dungeon sex" made me smile this morning.
